versions.description:
Staff can jail a player for a set time. Use `setjail` to save the jail spot, then `jail <player> <minutes> <reason>`. The player is teleported to the jail. Every minute a cron job checks their position: if they moved further than the configured radius, they are teleported back. When the time is up they are released automatically, back to where they were or to a release point (`setjail release`). Staff can release early with `unjail <player>` and see everyone in jail with `jailed`. Jailed players check their remaining time with `jailtime`.

Optional: pick a **Jailed role** in the config. It is given on jail and removed on release, so you can see jailed players on the dashboard, link it to a Discord role, or check it in your own modules.

**Limits.** Takaro cannot block commands from other modules, and Takaro roles only add permissions, they never take them away. Anything the default Player role allows (for example teleport commands) still works while jailed; the cron job then pulls the player back within a minute. Only grant escape commands through roles other than Player if you want jail to be strict.

Needs a game whose connector can teleport players and report their position (for example 7 Days to Die, Rust, Minecraft, Valheim, Conan Exiles, Project Zomboid, Terraria). On other games the `jail` command fails with a clear message and nobody is jailed.

commands.name: setjail
commands.description: Save your current position as the jail (or as the release point)
commands.helpText: Staff: /setjail saves your position as the jail. /setjail release saves it as the release point.

commands.name: jail
commands.description: Jail a player for a number of minutes

commands.name: unjail
commands.description: Release a player from jail now

commands.name: jailed
commands.helpText: Staff: /jailed lists everyone in jail with time left and reason.

commands.name: jailtime
commands.description: See how long you are still in jail
commands.helpText: Shows your remaining jail time and the reason.

hooks.name: on-connect
hooks.description: Put a jailed player back in jail when they reconnect, or finish a release that happened while they were offline

cronJobs.name: jail-enforcer
cronJobs.description: Every minute: teleport jailed players back when they left the radius, and release players whose time is up

functions.name: jail-helpers

permissions.description: Allows staff to set the jail, jail and unjail players, and list jailed players.
